description: Switch your account from the Contingency plan to Standard, where each business is billed every month, whatever review sites it is tracked on, and each confirmed removal costs less. The first call changes nothing and answers the price with a confirmation: show the person the confirmation, wait for their yes, then call again with the quote_id and a new idempotency_key you keep for retries. Stripe charges the first month to the card on file at once; if the card is declined, nothing changes. What a person may say: "switch my RepuTend account to Standard".

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

idempotency_key.description: With quote_id: a unique value you choose for this switch and keep; a retry with the same value answers the first result.

quote_id.description: The quote_id of the price the person said yes to.

name: switch_plan
title: Switch to the Standard plan
